import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity_trial_2/msd.dat', comments='#')

time_ps = data[:, 0]  # Time in ps
msd_A2 = data[:, 1]   # MSD in A^2

# Convert units
# Time: ps to s
time_s = time_ps * 1e-12

# MSD: A^2 to m^2
msd_m2 = msd_A2 * 1e-20

# Find the linear region (typically after initial ballistic regime)
# Looking at the data, the linear region appears to start around 50 ps
# We'll use data from 50 ps to 500 ps for the fit
start_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(time_ps - 50))
end_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(time_ps - 500))

# Extract linear region
time_fit = time_s[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_m2[start_idx:end_idx]

# Perform linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # This is d(MSD)/dt in m^2/s

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = (1/6) * d(MSD)/dt
D = slope / 6.0

print(f"Linear fit region: {time_ps[start_idx]:.1f} ps to {time_ps[end_idx]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope (d(MSD)/dt): {slope:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D: {D:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D:.2e}")

# Create a plot to visualize the fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_A2, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_ps[start_idx:end_idx], msd_A2[start_idx:end_idx], 'r-', 
         label=f'Linear fit region ({time_ps[start_idx]:.0f}-{time_ps[end_idx]:.0f} ps)', linewidth=2)

# Plot the fitted line
msd_fit_A2 = (coeffs[0] * time_fit + coeffs[1]) * 1e20
plt.plot(time_ps[start_idx:end_idx], msd_fit_A2, 'g--', 
         label=f'Linear fit', linewidth=2)

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Square Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusion_coefficient_trial_2/msd_fit.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved to msd_fit.png")

# Also save the result to a file
with open('/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusion_coefficient_trial_2/diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
